description: Madagascar - Wind Capacity Factor is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Wind", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. The dataset contains average wind power plant capacity factors in Madagascar, produced by KTH-dESA. The dataset has a 1km x 1km resolution. Coverage: Madagascar. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Wind. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
